video.text: Coding agents write code. Who checks the plan, the cost and the tests?
Agent Dev Crew runs a team of agents and keeps a trace of every step.
You approve the plan, or ask for changes, before any code.
Every step shows its prompt, tools, tokens, cost and time.
Hidden tests, never shown to the agents, decide if it passed.
A run can propose a rule. It joins the playbook only if you approve.
Hard set: one agent 100%, crew 88%, at half the cost.

gif.text: You approve the plan. Nothing runs before that.
Engineer, Reviewer and QA. QA sends it back once.
A tested diff: 6 of 6 hidden tests pass.
A run can propose a rule. It joins the playbook only if you approve.
